prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A stylish young man walks confidently toward the camera against a seamless, pure white background, creating a minimalist and modern aesthetic. He wears a light gray dress shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, paired with a beige vest that adds a touch of vintage sophistication. His dark, slim-fit trousers contrast sharply with the light upper half of his outfit, and he completes the look with tan lace-up boots. The man’s hair is tousled and slightly messy, giving him a casual yet fashionable appearance. His expression is neutral and focused, exuding quiet confidence. The lighting is soft and even, eliminating shadows and emphasizing the crispness of the scene. The composition is centered, with the subject in full stride, captured mid-motion, lending a sense of dynamism and purpose. The overall style is clean, editorial, and contemporary, reminiscent of high-fashion lookbooks or minimalist advertising campaigns, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus entirely on the subject.
